headline: Fronts Quiet Elsewhere as Dead Lands Fishermans Row Churn
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the map shows a mixed picture. Fishermans Row, which logged three captures in the prior two‑hour window, has recorded no fresh flips in the latest two hours and only three in the past six, leaving its 24‑hour total at twenty‑three. Dead Lands remains the bloodiest sector, adding roughly 1,700 colonial and 2,200 warden casualties in the last two hours, yet ownership changes have slipped to fourteen for the day, down from sixteen. In contrast, Stema Landing erupted with six captures in the last six hours, all centred on The Wane, and Tempest Island registered its first recent activity with a capture at Blackwatch early this morning. Godcrofts added one new flip in the past six hours, keeping its day‑total at nine, while Lykos Isle recorded three fresh turns around Fort Guile and The Squall. The massive attrition corridors — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to post rising casualty rates but no territorial movement. Overall strategic‑base ownership remains largely static, with Colonials holding the western and southern belts and Wardens the northern and eastern arcs.
